summary: Someone seeing conditions worsen decides to attend a protest for the first time.
realLife: owner, Nov 8: A person’s route into politics may begin with the state of the place around them.
inGame: needs: match a local issue record and an existing public action to the resident’s first participation.

turns.what: The resident attends the next public gathering after missing the first one.
turns.pulledBy: Their shift overlapped the first meeting and conditions remain unresolved.
turns.writesBack: The later gathering becomes their first attendance.

turns.what: At her first protest the resident stays for the testimony about her water bill and leaves to collect her child.
turns.pulledBy: The speakers reach utility costs before the resident’s pickup time.
turns.writesBack: She can recall the testimony she heard, while the later march is outside her account.
